title: AP2 x402 Cart Correlation
description: Correlates a built AP2 CartMandate (cart_root, cart_items, merchant) against an x402_spend_evidence pack: does the cart total (sum of quantity*unit_price per currency) match the x402 authorization's value, does the CartMandate's merchant map to the authorization's recipient address, and does the CartMandate's own hash-chain independently re-verify against the supplied cart_items (never trusted as a self-reported flag). Output vocabulary is CORRELATION_STATUS (CORRELATED / NOT_CORRELATED / INDETERMINATE) -- this is a plausibility check over two independently-produced artifacts, never a cryptographic binding. Google has not shipped an AP2-compatible x402 extension; no field or code path here implies one exists. Zero network calls; never a facilitator, proxy, gateway, or settlement relay.

cart_root.description: Required. The built CartMandate's own cart_root (e.g. art-595's output_payload.cart_root).

cart_items.description: Required, non-empty, ordered array of cart line items -- the SAME cart_items the CartMandate was built from. Each item needs sku, description, quantity (positive number), unit_price (non-negative number), currency.

merchant.description: Required. The built CartMandate's own merchant field. Only a 20-byte hex address can be correlated against the x402 authorization's recipient -- a free-text merchant name reports INDETERMINATE for that check.

token_decimals.description: Required. The payment token's decimals (USDC = 6). An EIP-3009 authorization's `value` is denominated in the token's atomic base units, so the cart total is converted to atomic units with this exponent and the two sides are compared as exact integers. Without it the comparison is meaningless: a correct 1 USDC payment (value "1000000") against a 1.00 cart read as CART_TOTAL_MISMATCH.

x402_spend_evidence.description: Required. The caller-assembled x402_spend_evidence object (field names fixed by SPEC-X402-CRYPTO-CORE-1-2026-08-09.md section 8) from the x402-spend-evidence chain. `authorization.value` MUST be a non-negative integer in the token's atomic units; a decimal figure is reported as indeterminate, never rounded.

mcp_tool_definition.name: correlate_ap2_cartmandate_x402
mcp_tool_definition.description: Correlates a built AP2 CartMandate against an x402_spend_evidence pack: cart total vs authorization value, merchant vs authorization recipient, and an independently re-derived cart hash-chain check. CORRELATION_STATUS vocabulary only (CORRELATED/NOT_CORRELATED/INDETERMINATE) -- never implies cryptographic binding.

cart_total_atomic.description: The cart total in the token's atomic units, as a decimal integer string (null when the cart spans more than one currency, or the inputs were malformed).

authorization_value_atomic.description: The authorization's own `value` in atomic units, as a decimal integer string (null when `value` is absent or not a non-negative integer).

output_example.disclosure: This tool observes that the cart total and merchant identity are consistent with the x402 authorization's amount and recipient. It does not cryptographically bind the two -- no signature, hash, or on-chain reference ties this specific CartMandate to this specific x402 authorization. A party could present a valid CartMandate alongside an unrelated valid x402 authorization and this check would still report CORRELATED.
